assignments.title: Present Perfect: 10 sentences about your life
assignments.instructions: Write 10 sentences about your life experiences using the Present Perfect. Use ever, never, already and yet at least once each.

sampleFeedback.summary: Good range of experiences. Watch the position of 'already' and 'yet'.

corrections.original: I have been yesterday to the park.
corrections.corrected: I went to the park yesterday.
corrections.note: A finished time expression needs the Past Simple.

assignments.title: Opinion paragraph: remote work
assignments.instructions: After reading “Is Remote Work Here to Stay?”, write one paragraph (100–140 words) giving your opinion. Use at least three linking words.

assignments.title: Record a 2-minute self-introduction
assignments.instructions: Record yourself introducing yourself for about two minutes. Audio submission will be supported in a future version — for now, write notes of what you said.

assignments.title: Vocabulary: use 8 new words
assignments.instructions: Choose 8 words from your vocabulary list and write one example sentence for each.
